answer: Require each newcomer to walk a karst of unique, time-locked micro-tasks whose solutions cannot be batch-generated from one script. Only after emerging onto a ledge of several independently attested results does the key receive a grading seat. Peers also listen for an echo: nearly identical phrasing or lockstep submission times across many addresses collapse those keys into one actor and freeze their weight. Farms can still register en masse, but they cannot multiply influence without multiplying real, unshared work.
